meta.title: Why Your Coffee Costs More Every Year

scenes.title: Why your coffee costs more every year
scenes.say: Your morning coffee keeps getting more expensive. Here is why.

scenes.label: Rise in the average café latte price since 2020
scenes.say: Since 2020, the average café latte has gone up about thirty-eight percent.

scenes.title: Where the money goes
scenes.say: So where does your money actually go?

scenes.title: Where your $5.50 goes
scenes.say: The beans are only a small slice. Most of your money pays for rent and staff.

scenes.title: How to pay less
items: Brew at home twice a week
scenes.say: Want to pay less? Brew at home, use loyalty cards, and size down.

scenes.quote: The price of a cup is really the price of a city.
scenes.author: Sample quote
scenes.say: Because in the end, the price of a cup is really the price of a city.
